description: This file defines the WaypointProgressTracker class, which manages route following logic for objects moving along a waypoint circuit in a Unity game. It calculates target points based on the route, supports smooth and point-to-point progress styles, and provides public properties for AI or other scripts to access route progress info.

classes.name: WaypointProgressTracker
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour that tracks and updates an object's progress along a waypoint circuit, providing route position info and visual debugging Gizmos.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the tracker, creating a target transform if none is assigned, and resets progress variables.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets route progress, setting the initial target point to the first waypoint in the circuit.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Per-frame logic to update target position based on the selected progress style, advancing waypoints as needed, and computing progress metrics.

methods.name: OnDrawGizmos
methods.description: Draws debug lines and indicators in the editor scene view for visualization of the current route and target points.
